returns.title: Returns
returns.subtitle: See the returns buyers opened, the step eBay is waiting for and its deadline. Open one to approve it, mark it received or refund it where eBay allows.

filters.search: Search return ID, order ID or product…

bucketHint.unconfirmed: eBay has not confirmed this return recently, so its last known state may be out of date. Check it on eBay.
bucketHint.action_overdue: The date eBay expected your response by has passed.
bucketHint.action_due: eBay is waiting for an action from you on this return.
bucketHint.escalated: This return was escalated to an eBay case.
bucketHint.in_progress: The return is open and nothing is due from you right now.

activity.SELLER_MARK_AS_RECEIVED: Mark the returned item as received
activity.SELLER_PROVIDE_RMA: Give the buyer an RMA number
activity.REMINDER_FOR_REFUND_NO_SHIPPING: Refund the buyer (the item is not expected back)

empty.title: No returns yet
empty.description: Returns your buyers open on eBay will appear here.

emptyFiltered.title: No returns match your filters
emptyFiltered.description: Try another tab, store or search term.

detail.title: Return {{id}}
detail.loadFailed: This return could not be loaded
detail.loadFailedDescription: Try again in a moment, or open it on eBay.
detail.offline: eBay could not be reached just now, so this is the last state SellerHill saw. Actions are offered once eBay answers again.
detail.nothingToDo: Nothing is waiting for you on this return.
detail.journeyEmpty: eBay has not recorded any step yet.

confirm.approve: Approve this return request on eBay? The buyer will be told to send the item back.
confirm.mark_received: Tell eBay the returned item has arrived? Do this only once you have it in hand.
confirm.issue_refund: Refund {{amount}} to the buyer now? eBay moves the money as soon as it accepts this, and it cannot be undone from here.

done.approve: The return was approved on eBay.
done.mark_received: The item was marked as received on eBay.
done.issue_refund: The refund was issued on eBay.

history.BUYER_MARK_RETURN_SHIPPED: Buyer marked the item as shipped
history.SELLER_MARK_AS_RECEIVED: Seller marked the item as received

errors.actionsDisabled: In-app return actions are switched off on this platform. Answer the return on eBay.
errors.actionNotAvailable: eBay no longer offers this action on the return. Refresh and check what is waiting now.
errors.suspended: Your subscription is suspended, so return actions are paused. Settle the invoice on the Billing page.
errors.ebayRejected: eBay refused this action. Open the return on eBay to see why.
errors.unavailable: eBay could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.sandbox: Return actions are not available on the eBay sandbox.
errors.refundAmountUnknown: eBay did not report a refund amount for this return, so the refund has to be issued on eBay.
